name: Parabolic Sphere Tracing for Heterogeneous Media Gradient Estimation
definition: A method to estimate transmitted caustics by finding stationary optical paths through a heterogeneous refractive medium (glass panel) using a gradient-based optimizer. It computes the gradient of the optical path length (OPL) using paraxial ray theory to handle non-linear ray trajectories in varying index of refraction (RIF) fields.
